name: initial-governors
argv: ( for p in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*/scaling_governor; do printf "%s=" "$p"; cat "$p"; done ); rc=$?; printf "\n__M1P_RC__=%s\n" "$rc"

name: telemetry-capability
argv: ( set -e; for p in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy*; do for f in scaling_governor scaling_cur_freq cpuinfo_cur_freq scaling_min_freq scaling_max_freq; do printf "%s=" "$p/$f"; cat "$p/$f"; done; done; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do printf "%s " "$z"; cat "$z/type" "$z/temp"; done; for h in /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*; do printf "%s " "$h"; cat "$h/name"; if test -e "$h/in0_lcrit_alarm"; then cat "$h/in0_lcrit_alarm"; fi; done ); rc=$?; printf "\n__M1P_RC__=%s\n" "$rc"
